verdict.rationale: Bland documents a Triggers feature that watches for an event and acts on it, such as a support case being created causing an agent to call the customer. This is backed by post-call webhooks sent automatically when a call completes and by pathway webhooks that can run at any point in a conversation. Missing for 10: detail on how trigger rules and conditions are defined (event sources, filters, supported actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
